components.institution_label: Modified Duties for Birth/Adoptive Mother or Primary Caregiver
components.description: ACAF 1.60: on the birth or adoption of a child, an automatically approved modified-duties semester at full pay; the birth or adoptive mother or primary caregiver is released from onsite duties (classroom teaching, clinical placement, laboratory duties) for one semester (or its equivalent over two semesters); research and other offsite duties continue.
components.faculty_group_note: All full-time tenured, tenure-track, clinical or research faculty members (ACAF 1.60, all campuses)
components.eligible_parent_wording: birth or adoptive mother, or the primary caregiver of the child
components.caregiver_condition_wording: If the faculty member is the birth or adoptive mother, or the primary caregiver of the child; eligibility requires attesting that they are primary or secondary caregivers of the child(ren)
components.service_requirement: none stated (eligibility begins on the date of hire)
components.dual_employee_rule: each may take (both parents full-time faculty: one primary, one secondary caregiver; simultaneously or consecutively; normally not simultaneously in the same unit)
components.entitlement_note: Automatically approved on notification through the Modified Duties Semester form; the faculty member is 'entitled'; the approval settles the specific modified duties, agreed in writing with the unit head (V2).
components.duration_note: One semester, or the equivalent of one semester distributed over two semesters (R3c: coded at the relief amount, span in note).
components.time_window: must be concluded within the twelve-month period following the birth or adoption
components.notice: Modified Duties Semester form, normally at least four months before the start of the semester or as soon as possible
components.relief_note: Released from onsite duties (classroom teaching, clinical field placement, teaching/research/clinical laboratory duties); committee work and undergraduate advising 'should be modified'; research, scholarship and professional service not requiring onsite activities remain unchanged (onsite research-laboratory duties are released). May be spread as the equivalent of one semester over two semesters.

faculty_group: All full-time tenured, tenure-track, clinical or research faculty members are eligible for modified duties.

All full-time tenured, tenure-track, clinical or research faculty members, librarians, instructors and lecturers of either gender are eligible for a “modified duties semester.” Eligibility begins on the date of hire.
eligible_parent: If the faculty member is the birth or adoptive mother, or the primary caregiver of the child, the faculty member is released from onsite duties such as classroom teaching, clinical field placement, and teaching, research or clinical laboratory duties for one semester or the equivalent of one semester distributed over two semesters.
caregiver_condition: If the faculty member is the birth or adoptive mother, or the primary caregiver of the child, the faculty member is released from onsite duties such as classroom teaching, clinical field placement, and teaching, research or clinical laboratory duties for one semester or the equivalent of one semester distributed over two semesters.

In cases of childbirth or adoption, eligible faculty members are entitled to the equivalent of one “modified duties semester” per event, if they attest that they are primary or secondary caregivers of the child(ren).
entitlement: In the case of the birth or adoption of a child, a full-time faculty member will be automatically approved for the equivalent of one semester of modified duties.

In cases of childbirth or adoption, eligible faculty members are entitled to the equivalent of one “modified duties semester” per event, if they attest that they are primary or secondary caregivers of the child(ren).
The specific modified duties must be mutually agreed upon in writing by the faculty member and the academic unit head.
duration: If the faculty member is the birth or adoptive mother, or the primary caregiver of the child, the faculty member is released from onsite duties such as classroom teaching, clinical field placement, and teaching, research or clinical laboratory duties for one semester or the equivalent of one semester distributed over two semesters.
pay_fraction: The faculty member receives full pay and benefits during this semester.
relief: If the faculty member is the birth or adoptive mother, or the primary caregiver of the child, the faculty member is released from onsite duties such as classroom teaching, clinical field placement, and teaching, research or clinical laboratory duties for one semester or the equivalent of one semester distributed over two semesters.
Additionally, the faculty member’s departmental or administrative committee work and undergraduate advising duties should be modified to suit the needs of the individual and the academic unit.
Faculty responsibilities for research, scholarship and professional service that do not require onsite activities remain unchanged.
time_window: In the cases of birth or adoption, the “modified duties semester” must be concluded within the twelve-month period following the birth or adoption.
dual_employee_rule: If both parents are full-time faculty members employed by the University, they are both eligible for an automatic modified duties semester following the birth or adoption of a child.

The two modified duties semesters, with one person being the primary caregiver and the other the secondary caregiver, may be taken either simultaneously or consecutively, depending on the needs of the individuals and the academic unit(s).

notes: Governing documents in force: Faculty Manual Columbia (June 9, 2017), ACAF 1.60 Modified Duties Semester (rev. Dec 1, 2014), ACAF 1.31 tenure-clock extension (rev. Nov 11, 2014), HR 1.06 Sick Leave (rev. Feb 7, 2018), HR 1.07 FMLA (rev. Apr 19, 2016), HR 1.09 Other Leave with Pay (rev. Apr 12, 2017), HR 1.12 Leave Without Pay (rev. Apr 19, 2016). Superseded before the reference date and not coded from: 2018_03 (HR 1.06, Apr 2014) and 2018_05 (HR 1.09, Oct 2013).

Version: the ACAF 1.60 copy (2018_00_link) is a 2016-08-19 capture of the 2014-12-01 revision; nothing in the sources shows a later revision before 2018-03-13, but no version note confirms the copy for the reference date, so its components carry version_uncertain.

No dedicated paid parental or maternity leave exists in the sources. A birth parent's paid time off comes only from her own accrued sick leave (c8, 0 paid weeks, R1) inside the Faculty Manual disability leave (c9). The paid benefit is the full-pay modified-duties semester (c1), relief from onsite duties with research continuing.

c9 conflict: the Faculty Manual (June 2017) states the disability leave ('may not be denied'; normally not over 180 work days with pay or 180 calendar days combined; extendable to 365 at the president's discretion), as did HR 1.06 before 2018. HR 1.06 as revised 2018-02-07 no longer states a 180-day period and treats leave as a case-by-case ADA accommodation, but refers faculty to the Faculty Manual. Coded from the Faculty Manual, the faculty's governing document, and flagged conflicting_sources.

c4 automatic tenure-clock extension: its closed list of reasons is the birth or adoption of a child or the death of a spouse/partner or child. U1 read literally (a purpose outside health, family care, birth or adoption) would make it general_purpose; it is read as not general_purpose, since the closed list holds no ground outside the U1 categories. Flagged ambiguous (rule gap).

Calendar: semesters ('fall or spring semester', ACAF 1.60), kind of term stated, length not: calendar.kind = semester, and the term length follows R8's order. The Faculty Manual's 'salary for one semester' is pay only.
Annual leave (c15) is earned only by twelve-month faculty; academic-year (nine-month) faculty earn none, so the standard tenure-stream member has no vacation balance.

Sabbatical leave (Faculty Manual) is not a component: it is for professional projects and cannot be used for a birth. HR 1.09 court, death-in-family, military, voting, blood, bone-marrow and organ-donor leave, and administrative leave after an assault, are likewise not components.

Chain, birth parent: disability leave c9 (up to 180 calendar days, pay from own sick leave c8 within it, then advanced sick leave c10 after the balance) with FMLA c16 alongside from its start (concurrent_with); the modified-duties semester c1 (full pay, one semester, to be concluded within 12 months of the birth) is not linked: ACAF 1.60 says leave must be taken if complete release is needed 'during this period', and states no order against the leave.

Chain, non-birth parent: FMLA c16 (12 workweeks; its link to c9 is ignored for this role); modified-duties semester c1 (as primary caregiver) in lieu of c2 (secondary caregiver, negotiated relief); family sick leave c12 (10 days, own balance) unlinked.
